sentences.text: On 1.27, pods with lower `controller.kubernetes.io/pod-deletion-cost` values are preferred to be deleted first when a ReplicaSet scales down.

citations.quote: If `controller.kubernetes.io/pod-deletion-cost` annotation is set, then the pod with the lower value will come first.
